text:
Ravi Kapoor: Quick sync - vendor just flagged a MI300 firmware regression in the latest batch. They recommend a rollback to fw-1.4.2 for stability. Impact on our GA?

Hannah Li: Oof. Do we know which regions/nodes are affected?

OEM Vendor (Claire): Affected units are primarily EU-central and APAC preview racks. US-west + US-east unaffected. We can either rollback those racks or hold the global push.

Marco Ruiz: For marketplace release timeline we have two options: (1) soft launch US-only on schedule, (2) delay global and keep a single launch date. Thoughts?

Ravi Kapoor: Prefer option 1 if legal/comms can support regionized messaging. Keeps press windows intact.

Marketplace Ops: We need SKU gating in the marketplace UI. Can we surface per-region availability and a note about fw rollback?

Hannah Li: Yes, we can add region flags. Also need image variants: mi300-fw-1.4.2 and mi300-fw-1.5.0-rc. SI partners need both for validation.

OEM Vendor (Claire): We'll prioritize creating a backport image for the affected racks. ETA ~36 hours.

Marco Ruiz: Can we do a controlled canary: route 10% MI300 traffic in EU-central to fw-1.4.2 and keep the rest on H100/B200 fallbacks?

Ravi Kapoor: Good. Runtime routing rule should let us pin by region and percent. Also add a metric that counts fallbacks per-minute.

Hannah Li: Routing snippet I propose:
```
route_preferences:
  - region: eu-central
    prefer: [mi300-fw-1.4.2, h100, b200]
    canary_percent: 10
```
Keep it parametric.

eng-ci-bot: CI update - mi300 image pipeline failed test-suite 7 on fw-1.5.0-rc at 2026-04-21T09:12:03Z.

Marco Ruiz: Ok that matches vendor note. Action: Marketplace Ops, add per-region availability flag + "known issue" banner.

Marketplace Ops: Copy - will add flags and banner. Need final wording from comms.

Ravi Kapoor: Hannah, spin two marketplace images and tag them: rI-2026-04-mi300-1.4.2 and rI-2026-04-mi300-1.5.0-rc. Ensure SI and marketplace get access.

Hannah Li: Will do. Also opening ticket ENG-7521: smoke tests matrix across fw variants, batch sizes [1,8,32], seq [512,2048].

OEM Vendor (Claire): We'll supply a limited hot-spare pool in eu-central for the canary. You'll have 20 nodes ready.

Ravi Kapoor: Perfect. Comms note for partners: regionized GA, limited-capacity canary in eu-central, full global ramp once fw-1.5.0 is green. Avoid saying 'delay' in public.

Marco Ruiz: Legal ok with phrasing. Also add a partner-facing checklist: serials, image tag, test status, and expected availability date.

Marketplace Ops: Added checklist template to the partner folder. Linking shortly.

Hannah Li: ETA images pushed to staging in ~6 hours. Will post artifact links.

eng-ci-bot: Staging push complete - rI-2026-04-mi300-1.4.2 available at s3://redwood-staging/mi300/1.4.2 (2026-04-21T12:44:01Z).

Ravi Kapoor: Thanks. Next steps: (1) Hannah pushes images + notifies SI, (2) Marco updates marketplace gating, (3) Claire confirms hot-spare allocation, (4) reconvene 24h after canary metrics.

OEM Vendor (Claire): Confirmed hot-spare allocation. Will also monitor hw telemetry and ping if anything else shows up.

Marco Ruiz: Scheduling follow-up 2026-04-22T15:00Z. Closing for now.
